channel.title: ZeroTouch Support — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: Orateur Review (2026): AI Phone Receptionist From CHF 49/mo
item.description: Orateur prices by plan, each with an allowance of AI agent time. The site is in French only and prices are in Swiss francs.

item.title: MK Website Assistant Review (2026): AI Enquiry Bot From £39/mo
item.description: MK Website Assistant: AI Assistant Plus also costs from £290 and then £59 a month. Prices are "from" amounts, so the final set-up fee can be higher.

item.title: Landbot Review (2026): No-Code Chatbots, Free Plan, Starter €32
item.description: Landbot: Free is €0 for 100 chats a month, one seat, the full builder and templates. Starter keeps Landbot branding and has no own WhatsApp number.

item.title: Chatwith Review (2026): AI Agent From $9, Priced in Credits
item.description: Chatwith: Starter is $9 a month or $90 a year. The real price depends on credits, and the conversation estimates assume five replies at one credit each.

item.title: Vanity Number Review (2026): One-Time Fee From $99.99, No Refunds
item.description: Vanity Number: The catalogue is browsable by price band, from under $250 through $251 to $500, $501 to $1,000. You are buying the number only.

item.title: Help Scout Review (2026): Free for 5 Users, Standard $25 a Seat
item.description: Help Scout: Standard is $25 per user a month billed annually or $30 monthly, for up to 25 users. The Free plan caps you at 100 contacts a month and one Inbox.

item.title: bOnline Review (2026): UK Business VoIP From £7 a User
item.description: bOnline: AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95. BOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page.

item.title: Trackr Review (2026): From $10/mo, Checked Oct 2026
item.description: Trackr: Four tiers and no free plan, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify. The rating is 4.1 over 56 reviews on 12 September 2026.

item.title: SupportBee Review (2026): From $20/mo, Checked Oct 2026
item.description: SupportBee: Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month. Enterprise is listed as everything in Startup plus five named items.

item.title: Tidio Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.

item.title: StoreFAQ Review (2026): Success Costs You Page Views
item.description: StoreFAQ: Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving. The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase.

item.title: NeuroAds Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $19/mo
item.description: NeuroAds: Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%). Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews.

item.title: Cloze Review (2026): 25 Free Chats, Then $49/mo
item.description: Cloze: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. The second is the track record, or the absence of one.

item.title: AskNest Review (2026): 50 Free AI Replies, Then $4.99/mo
item.description: AskNest: All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial.

item.title: HelpCenter Review (2026): From $40/mo, Checked Nov 2026
item.description: HelpCenter: Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents. The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay.

item.title: respond.io Review (2026): From $79/mo, Checked Oct 2026
item.description: respond.io — Four tiers, billed on monthly active contacts rather than seats: Starter $79/month, Growth $159, Advanced $279, and Enterprise on quote.

item.title: Answering Service Care Review (2026): Price & Limits
item.description: Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.

item.title: Jotform AI Agents Review (2026): Conversations Are the Cap
item.description: Jotform AI Agents: Bronze is $34 a month, Silver $39 and Gold $99, each billed annually, with 'save up to 20%' against monthly billing; Enterprise is quoted.

item.title: ZenZap Review (2026): Flat Packages Replace Seats
item.description: ZenZap: Free at $0 with 'every feature, every integration', unlimited users and 100 AI credits a month. The pricing genuinely undercuts Slack.

item.title: Zendesk Review (2026): Copilot Needs the $115 Tier
item.description: Zendesk — Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. The prices shown are annual-billed.

item.title: Weave Review (2026): From $199 a Month, $149 Bundles
item.description: Weave's plans page (getweave.com/plans, read 13 October 2026) is now a configurator: the base plan starts at $199 a month.

item.title: Wati Review (2026): From €59/mo, Checked Sep 2026
item.description: Wati: Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, or €69, €149 and €349 billed monthly. The plan price is the smallest part of the bill.

item.title: Voye Review (2026): Yearly Billing Saves up to 20% on Bundles
item.description: Voye: $2.00 down to $1.20 per gigabyte, with 2, 8, 12, 25 and 50 eSIMs included. ESIM data pooling genuinely beats classic roaming for traveling teams.

item.title: UniTel Voice Review (2026): Extra Users Cost $9.99
item.description: UniTel Voice: Solo $9.99/mo, Team $19.99/mo and Office $29.99/mo, each with one toll-free or local number and unlimited calling and texting.

item.title: Textline Review (2026): Backup Credits Cost 33% More
item.description: Textline: Add-on message credits $0.03 each, bought in advance; backup message credits $0.04 each. Two costs are easy to miss and both are monthly.

item.title: SimpleTexting Review (2026): $29/mo Plus $10 for the Number
item.description: SimpleTexting: The credit plans themselves are $29 (500 credits), $49 (1,000), $79 (2,000), $109 (3,000), $229 (7,500), $399 (15,000).

item.title: Signal House Review (2026): 500 Numbers Cost Less Than 499
item.description: Signal House: $0.0050 from 500k segments a month, $0.0045 from 1m, $0.0040 from 2m, $0.0035 from 5m and $0.0030 from 10m. Take the entry rate with no minimum.

item.title: Salesmsg Review (2026): Calls Eat the Text Credits
item.description: Salesmsg — Monthly billing: Basic is $25 a month for 500 credits a month; Pro is $329 a month for 10,000 credits a month. Size the credits, not the headcount.

item.title: Ruby Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits
item.description: Ruby: $5.00 a minute at the bottom, $3.45 at the top. You're paying premium rates for real human receptionists billed per minute.

item.title: Pylon Review (2026): Enterprise Needs Seven Seats
item.description: Pylon no longer publishes rates. The per-seat sticker is the entry ticket; the AI that makes the platform sing is metered separately.
